QuestInfo.name: Admin's Heart
QuestInfo.0: Valentine's Day is a time of romantic inklings for the Maple Administrator, too. Wonder who her mysterious heart beats for?\n
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator used to have a crush on Gaga, but now she has a thing for Inkwell. Why not help her make her feelings known?\n
QuestInfo.2: You brought 100 Chocolates to the Maple Administrator, just the thing to help her make her dream of true love a reality!\n

0.0: Goodness, it seems like all of Maple World is abuzz over Valentine's Day this year. It kind of makes me wish I had someone to share it with... *Sigh* I remember when I had my crush on Gaga...he's such a sharp dresser, after all. In the end, though, I don't think we're a good match. The man I'm interested in is... Say, do you think you could help me?

yes.0: You see... I'm in love with Inkwell!
yes.1: Inkwell might seem too laid back, but he volunteered to help me when I was swamped with the Maple Awards. I guess his suave, understated charm and support won my heart... Now, I just need a way to tell HIM that! Chocolates might make it easier, hm? Could you bring me 100?

no.0: Maybe you're right... I'm probably better off just sticking with work.

1.0: You brought 100 Chocolates? Just for me?

yes.0: Thank you so much! My preparations are going much more smoothly thanks to you, XX! If you bring me 100 more, I should be ready to profess my love in no time.

item.0: That's not 100 Chocolates, is it? Please hurry, so I can enjoy this Valentine's Day to its fullest!
